title: Pager busy-handler installation and VFS hint

scope.rationale: sqlite3PagerSetBusyHandler is the atomic Pager boundary that stores the callback/context pair adjacently for retry sites and exposes the same pair to custom VFS implementations through the best-effort SQLITE_FCNTL_BUSYHANDLER file-control hint.
excluded_responsibilities: Connection-level busy callback policy and timeout sleeping

external_source_responsibilities: Pager owns an open database sqlite3_file
Connection callback adapter supplies source-compatible one-argument retry semantics
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete setter body and both adjacency assertions are assigned. Connection busy-handler and timeout APIs install Pager.pagerBusy; Pager lock paths consume the stored callback/context.

inputs: Live Pager, optional one-argument busy callback, and borrowed callback context
outputs: Installed callback/context pair and one best-effort SQLITE_FCNTL_BUSYHANDLER hint
contracts.ownership: Pager borrows callback and context for its lifetime or until replacement. The VFS receives a borrowed pointer to Pager-owned adjacent hint storage.
contracts.state_and_results: Every call replaces both fields, including null callback removal. The hint contains callback in slot zero and context in slot one and its result is intentionally ignored.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No callback is invoked during installation. xFileControl may inspect the pair synchronously and must not own it.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Unsupported or failing file-control hints do not fail installation; subsequent Pager lock retries use the newly installed fields.

representation_differences: Zig keeps runtime callback/context fields and a separate Pager-owned two-slot anyopaque hint array because optional function pointers cannot be reinterpreted as an adjacent object-pointer array directly.
The existing osFileControl wrapper returns the ignored result; this call site provides sqlite3OsFileControlHint semantics by discarding it.

oracle.protocol: Open a Pager through a native ABI VFS wrapper, intercept xFileControl, install callback/context, verify operation 15 and both argument slots, then invoke the stored callback and verify continuation state.
oracle.normalization: Pointer values are compared only for identity within one process; operation, callback result, and count are exact.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: The VFS hint is best-effort and does not alter Pager state on failure; connection serialization owns concurrent replacement.
assurance.malformed_input: Null callback and null context are valid and forwarded exactly.
assurance.continuation: After an unsupported hint, Pager lock retry paths still consume the installed callback/context.
assurance.performance: Constant-time field replacement and one optional VFS dispatch.

integration.production_owner: src/core/pager.zig Pager and src/core/sql_frontend.zig Connection busy adapter
integration.native_call_path: sqlite3_busy_handler/sqlite3_busy_timeout -> Connection.pagerBusy -> Pager.setBusyHandler -> sqlite3_file.xFileControl; lockShared and lockForWrite invoke the installed pair on source-approved transitions.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: The live Pager setter now includes the omitted custom-VFS hint rather than storing only native fields.

independent_review.notes: Requires scoped durable trace promotion and independent review.

known_blockers: Capture a scoped durable busy-handler/VFS-hint receipt before internal-trace promotion.
